color.name: Your Color
color.lead: You provide your own preset or Lightroom catalog with your color. Best if you already have your editing style and only need it applied consistently across the whole gallery.
included: Removing small unwanted elements (when possible in Lightroom)
Keeping your style consistent throughout the gallery

color.name: Custom Color
color.lead: Perfect if you don’t have your own preset or want me to create the best color for your gallery based on your references and lighting conditions.
included: Creating a custom color from scratch
Matching the color across the entire gallery

color.name: Color with Masks
color.lead: Used whenever Lightroom masks are required for color correction. Color only, it does not include skin retouching.
included: Everything in Your Color or Custom Color
Local color adjustments with masks, as needed for each image
Correcting skin tones in selected areas

skin.name: Detailed Retouch
skin.lead: Perfect for images that require a more detailed and refined retouch. The final price depends on the complexity of the image and the desired level of retouching.
included: Natural-looking results that preserve skin texture

factors: The final price depends on complexity, number of people in the frame, skin condition and RAW quality.
note: * The exact amount is confirmed once I see the full scope. Minimum order: 10 photos.
